		Dataset Description
	

BenchMAX_Question_Answering is a dataset of BenchMAX for evaluating the long-context capability of LLMs in multilingual scenarios.
The subtasks are similar to the subtasks in RULER.
The data is sourcing from UN Parallel Corpus and xquad.
The haystacks… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/LLaMAX/BenchMAX_Question_Answering.
reputation: Part of the BenchMAX suite; an emerging multilingual long-context QA benchmark gaining attention for cross-lingual and long-context evaluation.
